property_summary: After a flash-governance deposit is recorded and the unlock time passes, withdrawGovernanceAsset must succeed for any recorded amount > 0 (and clear the pending decision); the mutant's `amount == 0` check reverts on every nonzero amount.
change_summary: Change the amount check from `> 0` to `== 0`, so withdrawals are only allowed when the recorded amount is zero, changing both revert behavior and (when allowed) the deletion of stored state.
